tagline: 尼康数码单反相机，2010 年发布
description: 尼康于2010年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable, Nikon F-mount。快门速度Electronically-controlled vertical-travel focal-plane shutter。

specs.传感器: 23.6 mm × 15.6 mm Nikon DX format RGB CMOS sensor, 1.5 × FOV crop, 4.78 μm pixel size
specs.曝光测光: TTL 3D Color Matrix Metering II metering with a 2,016 pixel RGB sensor
specs.对焦: Manual, Auto, Focus-lock, Electronic rangefinder, Live preview and video modes: Subject-tracking, Face-priority, Wide-area, Normal-Area
specs.闪光灯: Built in Pop-up, Guide number 13m at ISO 100, Standard ISO hotshoe, Compatible with the Nikon Creative Lighting System, featuring commander mode for wireless setups
